title: Abba Tzidoni
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Kohelet Rabbah 7:3 mentions him together with Rabbi Abba’s disciples, reporting Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel; the reading there is Rabbi Ami’s disciples. Hyman explains that this is the intention of Seder HaDorot’s words “and Midrash Shmuel, chapter 23, and Rabbi Ami’s disciples.” What belongs together has been needlessly separated: it should read “and Midrash Shmuel, chapter 23, with Rabbi Ami’s disciples.”

notes.text: Hyman’s point is a punctuation/connection error: with the disciples, not an independent name after and. Abba and Ami remain the reported readings.

The consulted Kohelet Rabbah 7:1:3 names Rabbi Abba’s disciples and Abba Tzidoni in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman; Midrash Shmuel 23:4 has Rabbi Ami’s disciples and the same transmitter. Hyman’s supplied text instead has רשב״ג, rendered here as Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel. The consulted Seder HaDorot places “and Rabbi Ami’s disciples” after the Midrash Shmuel reference; Hyman argues that these words belong with that reference.
